Item.Name: PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter value for product code or use [LISTVAL]
Item.Label: Product Code

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select components.product_code, product_desc
 into :product_code, :s_product_code_desc
 from components, valid_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
--HCLC component_prefix = 1 and
 components.product_code = :product_code and
 reject_reason_code is null and
--HCLC components.product_code =
 substr(components.product_code,1,5) = 
 valid_products.product_code and
 valid_products.unit_scheme_type = :scheme_type and --Modified for code128 standards
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and
 component_status = 'L';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
IF :scheme_type = 'C' THEN
 begin
 select min(component_prefix)
 into :component_prefix
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 reject_reason_code is null and
 component_status = 'L';
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
ELSE
 :unit_add_on_bags.component_prefix := SUBSTR(:unit_add_on_bags.product_code,7,2);
END IF;

end;

Item.Name: INSERT_DATS_TEMP
Item.Hint: Enter process date and time in format: (MM-DD-YY HH:MI) or leave blank

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_gmt_time date;
 
 l_insert_dats date;
 g_insert_dats date;
begin

--MS Converting GMT time to Local time.
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 l_insert_dats := v_local_time;
 else
 l_insert_dats := :unit_add_on_bags.insert_dats;
 end if;
--

--MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if :unit_add_on_bags.insert_dats_temp is not null then
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :insert_dats_temp, v_gmt_time);
 g_insert_dats := v_gmt_time;
 :insert_dats := v_gmt_time;
 else
 g_insert_dats := :insert_dats;
 :insert_dats := :insert_dats; 
 end if;
 elsif :unit_add_on_bags.insert_dats_temp is null then
 :unit_add_on_bags.insert_dats := null;
 end if;
 
--
/* MS
 if :insert_dats is null then 
 :insert_dats := sysdate;
 else
 if :insert_dats >sysdate then 
 show_error('8030');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if :insert_dats < :coll_date then
 show_error('8060');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
*/

--MS
 if :insert_dats_temp is null then 
 :insert_dats_temp := l_insert_dats;
 :insert_dats := sysdate;
 else
 if g_insert_dats > sysdate then 
 show_error('8030');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if g_insert_dats < :coll_date then
 show_error('8060');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
--

end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :unit_add_on_bags.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :unit_add_on_bags.bags_used := 0;
 :unit_add_on_bags.segment_number := :ctrl_blk_3.segment_number;
 :unit_add_on_bags.segment_rem_flag := :ctrl_blk_3.segment_rem_flag;

 :weld_flag = 'N'
 then
 begin
 update components
 set reject_reason_code = 'WELD' ,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc (:coll_date) and 
 chapter_id = :chapter_id and
 product_code = :unit_add_on_bags.product_code and
 component_prefix = :unit_add_on_bags.component_prefix;
 exception

 then 
 message('Error in rejecting component');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if nvl(:unit_add_on_bags.number_of_bags,0) > 0
 then
 begin
 update units
 set add_on_bags = nvl(add_on_bags,0)+ nvl(:unit_add_on_bags.number_of_bags,0) ,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc (coll_date) = trunc (:coll_date) and 
 chapter_id = :chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS

 message('Error in updating units');
 handle_error;

 end;
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select lot_number from valid_lots where bag_code = 'BA' and :ctrl_blk_1.item_ind in ('SE','BA') and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id /* modified by hcl consulting */ union select lot_number from valid_lots where bag_code = 'FI' and :ctrl_blk_1.item_ind in ('FI','FB') and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id /* modified by hcl consulting */ order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: UNIT_ADD_ON_PROD_CODE_LOV
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct components.product_code, product_desc from components, valid_products where unit_id = :unit_id and to_char(coll_date,'MM-DD-YY') = to_char(:coll_date,'MM-DD-YY') and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and component_prefix = decode(length(:unit_id),13,'00','1') and reject_reason_code is null and substr(components.product_code,1,5) = valid_products.product_code /* hclc */ and valid_products.unit_scheme_type = decode(length(:unit_id),13,'I','C') and /* modifed by hclc according to code 128 standards */ sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) and component_status = 'L' order by 1
